tweet.text: I think @ZackKorman said it best when he said security people need to take our shit back. The ball is in our court but it’s going to take some losses before things balance out again. Too many of us are silent in this community many due to bias others out of fear but the bottom line is that both ourselves as practitioners, professionals, and everything else in between, including the technical aspects of cyber as a science if nothing else, are being grossly misrepresented by people who are larping as being “experts” to conduct lawfare and generational collusion.
